verdict.rationale: The Colorado Secretary of State is a state government business registry and filing office. Its records are public filings held by the state under its own jurisdiction, so a user choosing a data-storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it offers any residency selection that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
